results.content:
When asked in April 2025, Trump's first three months were rated at 61% approval by Oklahoman polltakers. Now in August 2026, Trump remains at 52% approval in Oklahoma.

Nationally, Trump has an unfavorable majority across all ages, education levels, genders, and races. Trump's only favorability among Civiqs' demographics is found in the 82% of Republicans who remain faithful to the president. [...] According to Civiqs, the Republican president holds a strong approval rating in Oklahoma among several demographics, including all poll takers 35 and older, postgraduate-educated individuals, non-Republicans and non-white people.

Oklahoma's party lines mimic that of the national level. Oklahoma D

results.content:
By  Devanshi Basu

State-level approval map 18 months into President Donald Trump‘s second term reveals that his political footing has slipped significantly since his return to the White House. A new Civiqs analysis tracking 117,851 registered voters shows once-reliable territory now looking far less certain, raising questions for Republicans ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

## Donald Trump’s approval rating stands at 37 percent nationally ahead of the 2026 midterms [...] Civiqs compared President Donald Trump’s standing on July 17, 2026, with his numbers on Inauguration Day 2025. The national picture shows 37 percent approval against 58 percent disapproval, producing a net score of -21
results.title: Donald Trump’s State Approval Map Has a Midterm Warning

results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. [...] At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net approval rating of -10. His current net rating of -23 leaves him 13 point
